description: This Java source file defines the KeyboardSwitcher class, which manages keyboard layouts, modes, and switching logic for an Android soft keyboard application. It handles different input modes (text, symbols, phone, URL, email, IM, datetime, numbers), manages keyboard cache, supports cycling through various keyboard layouts, and maintains mappings per app package. It also provides interfaces for keyboard switching events and manages external dependencies such as keyboard add-ons and preferences.

classes.name: KeyboardSwitcher
classes.description: Manages keyboard layouts, modes, and switching logic for an Android soft keyboard app, including handling input modes, cycling through keyboards, and maintaining mappings per app package.

classes.name: KeyboardSwitcher.KeyboardSwitchedListener
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when the keyboard layout changes, including setting alphabet and symbol keyboards and notifying available keyboard changes.

classes.name: KeyboardSwitcher.NextKeyboardType
classes.description: Enumeration of different keyboard switching modes, such as Symbols, Alphabet, Any, and navigation modes.

methods.name: getKeyboardMode
methods.description: Determines the keyboard mode based on EditorInfo inputType, mapping to internal mode constants.

methods.name: setInputView
methods.description: Sets the current InputViewBinder and clears keyboard caches.

methods.name: getSymbolsKeyboard
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a symbols keyboard layout based on index, with caching.

methods.name: createGenericKeyboard
methods.description: Creates a new GenericKeyboard instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: getAlphabetKeyboards
methods.description: Returns the array of alphabet keyboards, ensuring they are built.

methods.name: getEnabledKeyboardsBuilders
methods.description: Returns a list of enabled keyboard add-on builders.

methods.name: ensureKeyboardsAreBuilt
methods.description: Initializes keyboard arrays and builders if not already built.

methods.name: findIndexOfInternetInputLayout
methods.description: Finds the index of the internet input layout in the keyboard list.

methods.name: setKeyboardMode
methods.description: Sets the current keyboard mode based on input mode, EditorInfo, and restart status, switching layouts accordingly.

methods.name: nextKeyboard
methods.description: Returns the next keyboard layout based on the specified navigation type.

methods.name: nextAlterKeyboard
methods.description: Switches to an alternate keyboard layout (e.g., Alt symbols).

methods.name: isCurrentKeyboardPhysical
methods.description: Checks if the current keyboard is a physical (hard) keyboard.

methods.name: onLowMemory
methods.description: Releases non-current keyboard instances to free memory.

methods.name: shouldPopupForLanguageSwitch
methods.description: Determines if a language switch popup should be shown.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Disposes resources, saves mappings, and clears caches.
